_about: Braid (System: core / story) numbers, read by sheet.py, mechanics.py and npc.py. Rules text: SKILL-core.md. Our defaults, adjustable; sources noted where a number follows a published game's mechanic (no text taken).

thresholds.note: Wounded: -1 on Force and Finesse until harm drops below 2
Badly hurt: -1 on every roll until harm drops below 3
Taken out: out of this scene. The player picks one: knocked cold, captured, lost, or (deadly danger only) dying unless someone helps before the scene ends
Breaking point: no more pushes. Take a lasting scar (a condition, -1 on one approach, cleared at a milestone), then set stress to 0

xp_marks.drive: acted on your drive and it cost you something (once per session)
xp_marks.flaw: your flaw made real trouble (once per session)
xp_marks.miss: a miss taught you something (1 per session, our default)
xp_marks.milestone: the party finished something that mattered (2 XP, the GM names it)

advances.label: a new label
advances.move: a new move: one narrow thing you do better than anyone, in one line

1.what: a nuisance: a thug, a guard dog, a pickpocket

2.what: trained: a soldier, a cultist, a wolf

3.what: dangerous: a veteran, a beast, a gunman behind cover

4.what: formidable: a champion, a monster, a war machine

5.what: overwhelming: a dragon, a tank, a god's hand
